remainingLimits: Direct unshadowed eval calls only; indirect eval, vm APIs and Function execution are not modeled as confirmed sinks.
Static Express app/Router methods and mounts, literal relative CJS/ESM imports, bounded constructors/closures only.
Legacy MongoClient.connect callback Db contract requires a declared 2.x dependency family; actual installed version and server-side JavaScript settings unverified.
Direct MongoClient instance/db/collection contracts are limited; complex wrappers, monkey-patching, middleware ordering and dynamic routes stay unknown.
NodeGoat $where reaches an unverified receiver after conservative cross-object handling; not connected as a verified Finding.
Authentication references and resource access are not ownership/authorization proof; no IDOR/BOLA Finding added.
NestJS decorators, Next.js route handlers, full program flow and arbitrary mutable captures are unsupported.
No independent external vulnerable/fixed Express pair was acquired. Official example scope observations and same-curator synthetic cases cannot establish general precision/recall.

safety.externalReads: Official Express/MongoDB documentation and five anonymous GitHub static metadata/file reads for two official Express examples plus license; no source attacks or token validation.
